instruction.name: VPSHUFBITQMB
instruction.copyright: Copyright (C) Intel Corporation. All Rights Reserved.
instruction.shortdesc: Shuffle Bits From Quadword Elements Using Byte Indexes Into Mask

para.string: The VPSHUFBITQMB instruction performs a bit gather select using second source as control and first source as data. The value of each output bit is identified using 6 control bits from the second source operand to select a data bit to be gathered from one of 64 contiguous bits of data in the first source operand.
Each byte of the second source operand provides a 6-bit index that gives access to 64 bits (2
=64) within each respective quadword 64-bit lane (i.e., index values in SRC2.qword[x] allow selecting bit values in SRC1.qword[x]).
Control data for each output bit is stored in 8 bit elements of SRC2, but only the 6 least significant bits of each element are used.
This instruction uses write masking according to the writemask k2 (zeroing only). This instruction supports memory fault suppression.
The first source operand is a ZMM/YMM/XMM register. The second source operand is a ZMM/YMM/XMM register or a memory location. The destination operand is mask register k1.
